descriptions.g-bookcircle|2025-02-06: Our first real meeting. Bring the book and a mug if you have a favorite, since the host has plenty of tea but not many cups. One guest each, and buzz 4C when you get there.
descriptions.g-coop|2025-02-15: Bring a dish to share with its own serving spoon, and label anything with nuts. Kids are welcome and there will be a coloring table in the corner. Up to three guests per household.
descriptions.g-otters|2025-03-08: Meet the coaches, pick up practice shirts and get the spring schedule. Kids should wear cleats, they will scrimmage for the last half hour. Parking fills up fast, so use the lot behind the tennis courts.
descriptions.g-bookcircle|2025-04-03: We finish talking through the March pick and choose what comes next, so come with one suggestion. It is a small room, so RSVP only if you are sure, and one guest at most.
descriptions.g-otters|2025-04-19: Full uniform please, socks up and shin guards on. Individual photos go first and the team photo is at 9:45. Order forms come home with the kids, nothing to pay on the day.
descriptions.g-coop|2025-04-26: We are building four raised beds and filling them with soil. Gloves and tools come from the tool library, but bring a water bottle and closed shoes. If it rains we move to the next Saturday.
descriptions.g-otters|2025-05-17: Last day of the season, with medals handed out around noon. The team covers sandwiches and fruit; families bring a side or dessert. Two guests per family, and babies under two do not need a place.
descriptions.g-bookcircle|2025-06-05: Outside at the courtyard tables for the first time this year, so bring a cushion and bug spray. If it rains we move to the community room. Members plus one guest.
descriptions.g-coop|2025-06-14: A family film projected on the courtyard wall once it gets dark, around 8:45. Bring blankets or a folding chair; popcorn is on the co-op. Quiet hours start at 10:30 and we will wrap up before then.
descriptions.g-bookcircle|2025-08-07: Bring up to five books you are done with and leave with as many as you like. Anything left over stays on the community room shelf for the building. No reading required, one guest each.
descriptions.g-coop|2025-08-23: Clearing out abandoned bikes and old parts before the new keys go into use. Residents only, no guests. Bring your old key to swap at the office, and tag your bike if you want it to stay.
descriptions.g-otters|2025-08-30: New season, new roster. Hand medical forms to the assistant coach, try on jerseys from the swap box, and stay for a short chat about the snack rota. It will be hot, so send a full water bottle and sunscreen.
descriptions.g-bookcircle|2025-10-02: Back indoors at the host's flat for the cooler months. Please arrive by 7 so we can start on time, and message the host ahead if you are bringing your one guest.
descriptions.g-otters|2025-10-04: Hay ride, a small corn maze and one pumpkin per player, paid from the team fund. Wear boots, the paths get muddy. Carpools leave the park lot at 9:30, so tell the assistant coach if you have spare seats.
descriptions.g-coop|2025-10-11: Pulling the summer beds, planting garlic and raking leaves into the compost bays. The tool library brings rakes and the post-hole digger for the new fence posts. Coffee from 9, one guest per household.
descriptions.g-otters|2025-11-08: Every player gets a certificate and the team award winners get trophies. Helpers, please claim a slot on the sheet for hall setup or snacks. Two guests per family, so grandparents can come.
descriptions.g-bookcircle|2025-12-04: The group has grown, so we are in the community room this time. The host is bringing cake and there will be hot cider. Bringing a short poem to read aloud is optional; one guest per member.
descriptions.g-coop|2025-12-13: Help string lights in the courtyard trees at 5, then come inside for food and cocoa. Claim a main, side or dessert on the dish sheet. Up to three guests, and kids can decorate cookies at the back table.
descriptions.g-coop|2026-01-24: Residents only, no guests. On the agenda: the board report, next year's budget, and votes on the courtyard beds and bike room tags. Childcare in the side room if you mention it in your RSVP.
descriptions.g-bookcircle|2026-02-05: Two new members join us tonight, so we start with quick introductions. Bring the book and any pages you flagged. One guest each, and boots off at the door please.
descriptions.g-otters|2026-02-07: Small-sided games in the gym to keep the kids moving over winter. Indoor shoes only, no cleats on the gym floor. One guest per family, and the bleachers are open for parents.
descriptions.g-coop|2026-02-21: This year the dish sheet is on the event page, so we do not end up with six pasta salads. Setup starts at 4:30 if you can lend a hand. Three guests per household, and please take your dishes home after.
descriptions.g-otters|2026-03-14: Games start the following Saturday, so this is the last chance to swap uniform sizes. If you have not paid spring fees yet, bring cash or a check for the assistant coach. Light rain does not cancel.
descriptions.g-coop|2026-03-28: Starting tomatoes, peppers and herbs in trays for the new courtyard beds. Soil and seeds are provided; bring egg cartons or yogurt cups if you have them. Twenty spots, one guest each, kids over six welcome to help.
descriptions.g-bookcircle|2026-04-02: We wrap up the winter pick and decide how to split the May book across two nights. Come up at 7, buzzer 4C. One guest each, and guests should tell the host who they are coming with.
